changelog: NEW: Added an optional manual ducking slider, allowing users to independently configure manual ducking strength without affecting auto-ducking settings.
NEW: Integrated a dynamic promotion detection system that automatically displays current special offers and discounts directly on the Pro version reference button.

CHANGED: Migrated the update checker framework from GitHub to the official website API; future update alerts will now direct users to a central download page on the official website, allowing them to choose their preferred distribution platform.
CHANGED: Implemented minor UI adjustments and visual refinements across several areas of the application to enhance interface consistency.
FIXED: Added missing translations for both the main user interface and the system tray context menu.
FIXED: Corrected and improved localization strings across all supported languages for better accuracy.

1.0.1.0: NEW: Added an optional manual ducking slider, allowing users to independently configure manual ducking strength without affecting auto-ducking settings.
NEW: Integrated a dynamic promotion detection system that automatically displays current special offers and discounts directly on the Pro version reference button.

CHANGED: Migrated the update checker framework from GitHub to the official website API; future update alerts will now direct users to a central download page on the official website, allowing them to choose their preferred distribution platform.
CHANGED: Implemented minor UI adjustments and visual refinements across several areas of the application to enhance interface consistency.
FIXED: Added missing translations for both the main user interface and the system tray context menu.
FIXED: Corrected and improved localization strings across all supported languages for better accuracy.
FIX: Resolved a logic issue where audio ducking would randomly interrupt and backgrounds sounds would prematurely return to default levels despite active communication.
FIX: Fixed a bug in the Audio Monitor where the name of the currently monitored application was not displaying correctly.
FIX: Fixed stability issues and eliminated critical bugs, significantly reducing potential application crashes during long-haul flights.
FIX: Resolved various minor bugs and optimized overall performance.
CHANGED: Implemented visual adjustments and UI refinements to enhance the interface's clarity.
CHANGED: Updated internal software libraries to ensure better compatibility with the latest Windows updates.
CHANGED: Refactored core components to minimize false positives in Windows Defender, which can occur due to the application's low-level integration with the Windows audio sub-system.
NEW: Added information and references regarding the launch of the new PRO version, which premieres alongside this 1.0.0 release.
